title: The Sound Studio
description:
Welcome to The Sound Studio—an upscale, one-bedroom, one-bath retreat in the heart of Nashville. Just minutes from Broadway’s live music and energy, this creative haven features a pro-grade recording studio, piano, and inspiring memory wall. Sip coffee or unwind with a drink on your private balcony overlooking the heated pool—perfect for relaxing after a night out.

The space
Nestled in a prime location south of Broadway (SoBro), this sound studio-inspired apartment is just steps from the city's vibrant music, dining, and entertainment scenes. 
Guest Services & 24/7 Front Desk Support

For added convenience during your stay, the building offers a 24-hour front desk available to assist with questions and provide on-site support whenever needed.

Guests also have access to additional concierge-style services upon request, including assistance with grocery needs, additional towels and pool towels, and other special guest requests. These optional services are available for an additional cost depending on the service requested.

If you would like to arrange any additional services during your stay, please reach out and I’ll be happy to assist with coordinating your request.
What Makes This Space Special:
*** Parking for 25 a night ***
🎶 Grand Piano – Bring your melodies to life in a space designed for creators.
🎶 Memory Wall – Perfect for capturing memories and sharing your stay online. Ring light available!  
🎶 Record Player – Enjoy your favorite vinyls in a truly creative environment.
🪑 Balcony – Cozy seating for two with views of the heated pool and courtyard.
💼 Stylish Workspace – Ideal for creators or remote workers.
🛏️ Plush Queen Bed – Your perfect rest awaits.
🍴 Full Kitchen – With premium appliances for all your culinary needs.
🛁 Bathtub + Shower – Relaxation at its finest.
☕ Coffee & Tea Supplies – Start your day with ease.
📺 Smart TV – For streaming your favorite shows.
📶 Reliable Wi-Fi – For browsing, streaming, or work.

Guest access
Enjoy exclusive access to resort-style amenities: 
🍀Guest Services & 24/7 Front Desk
If you would like to arrange any additional services during your stay, please reach out and I’ll be happy to assist with coordinating your request. 
🏙️ Sky Lounge – Breathtaking views of the Downtown skyline.
🏊‍♂️ Pool – Open year-round for your relaxation. pool is not heated!
🏋️‍♀️ Fitness Center – Including yoga studio.
🔥 Courtyard – Fire pits and outdoor grills for cozy evenings.
💻 Co-Working Space – Perfect for focused work sessions.
***Secure Garage parking for 25 $ a night!***

Other things to note
•	Parking: Secure garage parking available for $25 a night.
•	Flexible Check-In/Check-Out: Early check-in and late check-out available for a small fee.
Book Your Stay Today
This sound studio-inspired retreat offers the perfect mix of luxury, style, and functionality. Let me help make your stay unforgettable—whether you're here to create, relax, or explore. Reach out with any questions before booking, and let’s make your visit truly special.
